page.content:
1872–76 circumnavigation that founded modern oceanography.

How Challenger expedition connects

  • Item: HMS Challenger — HMS Challenger was the ship of the 1872–76 expedition.
  • Topic: Oceanography — The Challenger expedition founded oceanography as a global survey science.
  • Character: Charles Wyville Thomson — Charles Wyville Thomson led the Challenger science party.
  • Character: John Murray — John Murray served as naturalist and later edited the Challenger Report.
  • Location: Mariana Trench — Challenger sounded the deep that became Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench.

What is Challenger expedition?

HMS Challenger's scientific cruise sounded the deep, dredged new animals, and sampled chemistry worldwide. Its fifty-volume Report made oceanography a discipline rather than a navy sideline.

Key threads lead to HMS Challenger, Oceanography, Charles Wyville Thomson, John Murray and Mariana Trench.
